subject: Political Science
central_question: Why are international organisations necessary, how does the United Nations function, and why is reform difficult?
in_scope_units: Evolution and structure of the United Nations
UN reform after the Cold War
The UN in a unipolar world
banned_topics: Detailed history of the Cold War blocs

known_pitfalls.claim: The UN is a world government that can command all states.
known_pitfalls.correction: The UN is created by states and possesses only the authority that its members grant and obey.

known_pitfalls.claim: The General Assembly and Security Council have identical voting rules.
known_pitfalls.correction: Every state has one vote in the General Assembly, while five permanent Security Council members possess the veto.
